name: app-recipe-app-phone-over-cookbook-cutout
title: Recipe App over Cookbook Cutout
whatItIs: A cover with a hand holding a phone running a green recipe app, cut out with a white outline over a mint-toned open cookbook with oversized lettering.
whatItMeans: The printed cookbook backdrop connects the digital app to its analog roots. The white cutout outline gives a sticker-like pop.
techniques: Sticker-style white outline around the hand and phone
Color-tinted photo background matching the UI green
Big editorial title text partially hidden behind the device
Food photography inside the app screen
Playful yellow accent card in the UI

vocabulary.definition: A white border around a masked subject.
A photo colour-graded toward the brand hue.
Using a physical object to explain a digital product.
